verificationLimits: Native C# frame/order parity is not recovered; original exact fields and both actual chararts-bound face bytes are retained. No modules or authored Unity particles are represented.

Current bounded policy picks one seeded eligible ground-enemy tile from explicit3-16 range at release, respects current legal input and does not infer a fixed-forward distance from default _fixedDistance3. Original alwaysRandomInTheEnd1 is retained; native choice distribution and empty-field fallback are not claimed. There is no user tile-selection UI in this adapter. Explicit3-16 contains only {row:0,col:3}; chosen rounded center tile must itself remain in that range, even if a huge body overlaps it from a neighboring tile.

Native Projectile keepAlreadyHitTime1/canHitSameTargetMultipleTimes0 cache dispatcher and _hitAfterReached0 naming are unrecovered. No 30fps recording parity is asserted.

Original fixed CircleCollider radius1.1 and selected projectile_range1.3 are both retained. Adapter binds selected1.3 to S2 effect radius; native collider/BB geometry loading is not executable. Ordinary collider radius1 is literal.

Tests distinguish initial damage, later source modifiers and withdrawal rather than claim cached inheritance.

Native _ignoreCamouflage1 collision field is retained; this engine distinguishes camouflage from invisibility.
